title: Tender
description: A public tender, framework or call to join a supplier pool for creative work, as published by an official buyer. Facts only (title, buyer, number, dates) with a link to the official page. Never contact names, emails or phone numbers.

id.description: <source>-<native number>, e.g. mr-4000622386. Stable; never changes.

source_url.description: The official notice page (never an aggregator)

buyer_org_id.description: Org id in data/orgs when the buyer is in the directory

submission_opens.description: When submissions open (מועד תחילת ההגשה), Israel local time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Before it the tender is published but not yet open for bids: the site shows it as upcoming, never as open.

deadline_at.description: Submission deadline, Israel local time (Asia/Jerusalem), YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM

status.description: As published (open = published and not cancelled). The site computes the state against the current time: upcoming before submission_opens, open until deadline_at, then closed; cancelled always wins.

scope_summary.description: One line in our own Hebrew words: what is being bought

fee_ils.description: Fee to buy the tender documents, if any

link_only.description: The source's terms restrict reuse: show title, buyer, deadline and the link only
